content.title: Is Justin Bieber going on tour in 2026?
content.text: 15 April 2026, 11:36 Will Justin Bieber go on tour in 2026? Here's what we know. Picture: Johnny Nunez/Getty Images for The Recording Academy, Kevin Winter/Getty Images for Coachella Will there be a Swag World Tour? Here's what we know about Justin Bieber's tour plans after Coachella and why he took a step away from the stage. After surprise dropping his latest albums SWAG and SWAG II last year and now headlining Coachella, Justin Bieber fans are wondering if he will tour his new music.Justin made his grand return to music back in July 2025 with SWAG. He then followed that up with a second album, quietly announcing their releases just hours before they dropped. As it stands, Justin has only performed the songs in intimate venues and Coachella but is a world tour on the cards?Justin cut his last tour (Justice World Tour) short in 2022 in order to prioritise his health following his Type 2 Ramsay Hunt syndrome diagnosis. Here's everything we know about whether or not Justin will tour his new album.Read more: The real meaning behind Justin Bieber's 'Yukon' lyrics and who features on it explainedRead more: Justin Bieber Coachella setlist: Every song he performs in order Will Justin Bieber ever go on tour again? Picture: Getty Is Justin Bieber going on tour in 2026?So far, Justin Bieber has not confirmed if he'll be doing a tour for Swag. The pop superstar has been prioritising his health over recent years and had previously taken a step back from music and touring.In fact, it sounds like Justin has no plans to do a world tour anytime soon. Speaking on Twitch, Justin said: "I always start out really loving it, and then it always gets to a point where I’m just super burnt out." He went on to add that he may do "spot dates" instead of a long tour. On April 11th, Justin made his return to the global stage by headlining Coachella with a setlist comprised of songs from SWAG and SWAG II as well as his biggest hits. Whether or not he intends to take that show on the road, currently remains unclear.We'll update this article as soon as we know more information about Justin's live performance plans. Why did Justin Bieber take a break from touring?In 2023, Justin cancelled all remaining dates for his Justice World Tour after sharing that he had been diagnosed with Ramsay Hunt syndrome, a condition that left him suffering from facial paralysis. In statement at the time, Justin said: "After resting and consulting with my doctors, family and team, I went to Europe in an effort to continue with the tour. I performed six live shows, but it took a real toll on me. This past weekend I performed at Rock in Rio and I gave everything I have to the people in Brazil.“After getting off stage, the exhaustion overtook me and I realised that I need to make my health the priority right now. So I’m going to take a break from touring for the time being. I’m going to be ok, but I need time to rest and get better.“I’ve been so proud to bring this show and our message of Justice to the world. Thank you for your prayers and support throughout all of this! I love you all passionately!”Justin then took a break from music and touring. In July 2024, he made a rare return to the stage to perform a private pre-wedding ceremony concert for Anant Ambani and Radhika Merchant in Mumbai, India. He's since performed private gigs, two intimate shows at the Troubadour in West Hollywood and now Coachella.
